guidance.summary: Start with around 8 million units in year 1
guidance.quote: On the scale side, we expect to begin with around 8 million units in year 1, followed by a calibrated phase-wise ramp-up.

guidance.summary: Touch volumes of 13 to 15 million in second year
guidance.quote: If everything goes as scheduled, we expect to touch the volumes of around 13 million to 15 million in second year of operations.

guidance.summary: Local value addition to 35% to 40% in next 5 to 6 years
guidance.quote: And then we can take this local value addition to 35% to 40% in the next 5 to 6 years, depending on which category to add.

guidance.summary: Touching 8 million to 9 million phones in the very first year
guidance.speaker: Jasbir Singh
guidance.quote: I think we have a good task of about touching 8 million to 9 million phones in the very first year, taking this number to 14 million, 15 million next year.

guidance.summary: Taking this number to 14 million, 15 million next year
guidance.speaker: Jasbir Singh
guidance.quote: I think we have a good task of about touching 8 million to 9 million phones in the very first year, taking this number to 14 million, 15 million next year.

guidance.summary: ROCEs will be more than 30%, 35% on a standalone basis
guidance.quote: If you take this on a stand- alone basis, I mean, the ROCEs will be more than 30%, 35%.
